item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President is reporting to Congress that he previously issued an executive order declaring an emergency and establishing property-blocking and designation authorities; this segment does not itself impose those legal consequences, which arose under the earlier order.","evidence":"I hereby report that I have issued an Executive Order"},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President is reporting a prior delegation to the Treasury Secretary, implementation direction to agencies, and the earlier order’s effective time; the segment itself neither makes a new delegation nor changes legal rights.","evidence":"The order, a copy of which is enclosed, became effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern standard time on October 30, 2006."}]}
